sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Aches chiefly in forehead or orbits from full-
ness of brain ; worse any movement or mental exertion.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Pupils dilated, insensible to light. Eyeballs
painful to touch.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Breathing slow and sighing. Pulse rapid.
Palpitation. Sick feeling about heart, with weak piflse.
Bight ribs sore. Dropsical effusion into pleura or peri-
cardium.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:

approaching.
